card.name: Start of drug names in interaction lists
card.fires_on: The first letter C (or a joining word) right before a drug name starting with Ci, such as cimetidine, cisapride, cilostazol, cisplatin, cisatracurium or ciprofloxacin, inside lists of interacting drugs.

modes.label: C before Ci- drugs
modes.description: A lone C or c begins a drug name like cimetidine or cisapride after a comma in a drug list.
modes.example: GI Motility Agent<< C>>isapride Potential for serious and/or

modes.label: Joining word before a drug
modes.description: A word like or between drug names, just before a drug that starts with C.
modes.example: a combination of phentermine with fenfluramine<< or>> dexfenfluramine for weight loss

card.writes: It promotes pieces that begin C-words like Cal, CLA and ang, so it helps spell out a drug name starting with C.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter of a drug name beginning with Ci, like cimetidine, when it appears in a list of interacting drugs.
